name: RFP Pack on Signed Bid NDA
description: When a bid NDA sent from the bundle's RFP Bid NDA template is completed, the supplier who signed it (the envelope's first recipient) gets an email with the RFP pack link.

email.subject: Your RFP pack from Fontara
email.headline: Thank you for signing the NDA
email.body:
Dear {{start.FirstRecipientName}},
Thank you for signing the bid NDA. You can now download the RFP pack here: https://example.com/rfp-pack
Please send your questions and your response by the dates the pack gives.
